thread:
Ravi (PM): quick check-in - customer pilot target = next quarter. need clear owners for perf gate, infra prewarm, and KMS story. also confirm canary windows and rollback triggers.

Nina (Eng): I can take the rollout checklist + canary gating. will need 72h code freeze before the canary start.

Sol (Runtime): I will own runtime perf validation. plan: microbench (latency + memory), KV cache correctness tests, and a small regression suite. estimate 4 workdays total if given infra slot.

Priya (Infra): prewarm window available week of 2026-04-12. i opened INF-4327 for capacity + scaling policy changes. prelim numbers: 8 instances x p4d-ish equivalent.

Alex (Security): customer asked for HSM-backed keys + audit retention. HSM onboarding + policy review = ~10 business days. fallback = cloud KMS with enforced key rotation + full audit logs; needs written customer acceptance.

Ravi (PM): let's classify blockers: HSM = hard blocker unless fallback signed; KV cache correctness = hard; perf SLOs marginal = soft. agree?

Nina (Eng): agree. also add a monitoring SLO: 99th < 250ms for end-to-end request during canary. if breached 3x in 30m -> auto-rollback.

Sol (Runtime): adding perf target: p95 < 120ms/token on our canonical prompt set. will run candidate model v1 and v1-quant. note: 8-bit quant needs long-context regression.

Priya (Infra): INF-4327: policy change ETA 2026-04-09, prewarm run 2026-04-13. will attach runbook + rollback steps to the ticket.

Alex (Security): If HSM slips, propose path: (1) initial launch with cloud KMS in strict mode, (2) start HSM onboarding in parallel, (3) migrate keys during minor maintenance window. Need legal sign-off for key migration.

Nina (Eng): also: feature-flag gate for tenant. We'll flip flag in canary, monitor error-rate + latency, then ramp. I'll add the flag toggles to rollout doc.

deploy-bot: Canary planned at 2769456808 - window 45m. Respond with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

Ravi (PM): action items: Nina -> rollout doc + feature-flag plan + code-freeze timestamp by EOD; Sol -> perf microbench + KV regression by Thu; Priya -> INF-4327 capacity numbers + runbook by Mon; Alex -> HSM timeline + written fallback proposal for customer. reconvene in tomorrow's stand. thanks :pray:
